prompt: Which vehicle combination is legally authorized to be operated under a standard Texas Class C driver license?

options.text: A commercial truck and trailer combination with a GVWR exceeding 26,001 lbs
A passenger vehicle towing a trailer with a GVWR not exceeding 10,000 lbs
A school bus transport vehicle designed to carry more than twenty-four persons
A motorcycle or motor-driven cycle with an engine displacement over 250 cc
